question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"encounter."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Encounter"** means an unexpected or casual meeting with someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु से अप्रत्याशित या आकस्मिक मुलाकात)

 
 
• **Example**: *I had an unexpected **encounter **__with my old friend at the mall.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.
 
• **Correct sentence**: 

​......After that** __encounter__**, I did not see the leopard again.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2, "quarrel"**, means to have an argument or fight. (बहस या झगड़ा होना)
 
• **Option 3, "meeting"**, means a planned gathering or assembly. (एक नियोजित सभा)
 
• **Option 4, "exchange"**, means to give something in return for something else. (किसी और चीज़ के बदले में कुछ देना)
